title: Tool calls over time
description: Finished tool calls over time for the eight most used tools.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(tool_name)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, tool_name, count() AS calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' AND tool_name IN (SELECT tool_name FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY time, tool_name ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Top tools
description: Finished tool calls per tool, by agent type.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(tool_name), ' ', to_string(agent_type)) AS k FROM (SELECT tool_name, agent_type, count() AS calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' GROUP BY tool_name, agent_type ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 30) ORDER BY calls DESC

title: Tool duration (p95) by tool
description: 95th percentile duration in seconds, for the ten tools that took the most time in total. Calls without a reported duration are left out.
viz_content: SELECT tool_name, round(quantile(0.95)(tool_duration_ms) / 1000, 2) AS p95_seconds FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' AND tool_duration_ms > 0 GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY sum(tool_duration_ms) DESC LIMIT 10

title: Failed and blocked tool calls
description: Tool calls that failed, and calls a rule blocked, over time.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(outcome)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, if(event_type = 'tool_complete', 'failed', 'blocked') AS outcome, count() AS calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ((event_type = 'tool_complete' AND NOT tool_success) OR (event_type = 'tool_invoke' AND hook_decision NOT IN ('', 'observe', 'allow'))) GROUP BY time, outcome ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: MCP servers and skills
description: Tool calls per MCP server and skill uses per skill: the eight most used.
viz_content: SELECT kind, name, agent_type, uses FROM ( SELECT 'MCP server' AS kind, array_element(split_by_string('__', tool_name), 2) AS name, agent_type, count() AS uses FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type = 'tool_complete' AND tool_name LIKE 'mcp\\_\\_%' GROUP BY name, agent_type UNION ALL SELECT 'skill' AS kind, skill_name AS name, agent_type, count() AS uses FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_skills) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND skill_action = 'invoked' GROUP BY name, agent_type) ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 8

title: Repeated tool calls
description: The same tool with the same input three or more times in one session, a sign of a loop: the eight most repeated.
viz_content: SELECT session_id, any(agent_type) AS agent, tool_name, count() AS repeats, min(event_time) AS first_call, max(event_time) AS last_call, substring(any(tool_input), 1, 200) AS input FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND event_type = 'tool_invoke' GROUP BY session_id, tool_name, city_hash64(tool_input) HAVING repeats >= 3 ORDER BY repeats DESC LIMIT 8
